research.topic: Mock‑test analysis – why it sometimes stops boosting your scores
research.hook: 3 hidden reasons your mock‑tests aren’t helping – fix them in 60 seconds!
research.tip: After each mock, spend 10 minutes on a three‑step “Error‑type Sprint”: categorize every wrong answer, prioritize the top two cost‑liest categories, and create a 30‑second flash‑card for each to review over the next three days.

data.title: Mock Tests Mein Score Stuck Hai? Fix It in 60 Seconds
data.title_en: Mock Test Scores Plateauing? Fix It in 60 Seconds

scenes.text: Har mock test ke baad bhi marks stuck hain?
scenes.text_en: Are your scores stuck despite taking every mock test?
scenes.text_hi: हर mock test के बाद भी marks stuck हैं?

scenes.text: Problem mocks nahi, tumhara test analysis ka tareeqa hai.
scenes.text_en: The problem is not the mocks, but your analysis method.
scenes.text_hi: Problem mocks नहीं, तुम्हारा test analysis का तरीक़ा है।

scenes.text: Research-backed teen mistakes samjho, aur teesri sabse common hai.
scenes.text_en: Understand three research-backed mistakes, and the third is most common.
scenes.text_hi: Research-backed तीन mistakes समझो, और तीसरी सबसे common है।

scenes.text: Pehli mistake: sirf total score dekh kar test band kar dena.
scenes.text_en: First mistake: closing the test right after checking the score.
scenes.text_hi: पहली mistake: सिर्फ़ total score देख कर test बंद कर देना।

scenes.text: Doosri mistake: analysis sirf ek baar karna, spacing bhool jana.
scenes.text_en: Second mistake: reviewing errors only once, forgetting spaced repetition.
scenes.text_hi: दूसरी mistake: analysis सिर्फ़ एक बार करना, spacing भूल जाना।

scenes.text: Ye baat us batchmate ko zaroor bhejo jo roz mock deta hai.
scenes.text_en: Send this to that batchmate who takes mocks every single day.
scenes.text_hi: ये बात उस batchmate को ज़रूर भेजो जो रोज़ mock देता है।

scenes.text: Teesra: Dunlosky research ke mutabik error-type categorize na karna.
scenes.text_en: Third: failing to categorize error types, per Dunlosky research.
scenes.text_hi: तीसरा: Dunlosky research के मुताबिक error-type categorize ना करना।

scenes.text: Isko theek karne ke liye bas 10-minute Error Sprint karo.
scenes.text_en: To fix this, simply run a 10-minute Error Sprint.
scenes.text_hi: इसको ठीक करने के लिए बस 10-minute Error Sprint करो।

scenes.text: Pehle wrong answers ko conceptual, recall ya silly mistakes mein baanto.
scenes.text_en: First, sort incorrect answers into conceptual, recall, or silly errors.
scenes.text_hi: पहले wrong answers को conceptual, recall या silly mistakes में बांटो।

scenes.text: Phir top two categories ke flashcards bana kar spaced review karo.
scenes.text_en: Then make quick flashcards for the top two categories for spaced review.
scenes.text_hi: फिर top two categories के flashcards बना कर spaced review करो।

scenes.text: Aise analysis badloge, toh agle mock mein score zaroor badhega.
scenes.text_en: Change your analysis routine, and your next mock score will rise.
scenes.text_hi: ऐसे analysis बदलोगे, तो अगले mock में score ज़रूर बढ़ेगा।

data.description: Taking mock tests without a proper analysis loop stops your score from improving. Here are 3 science-backed reasons your mock scores plateau and how a 10-minute Error Sprint can fix it.

fixes: Combine the two ending actions into one clear CTA (e.g., ‘Do a 10‑minute Error Sprint and make flashcards’)
Add a visual timer cue for the 10‑minute sprint to boost engagement
Mention a specific exam like JEE/NEET for stronger Indian relevance
Trim scene 6 to keep beat every 2‑3 scenes, e.g., merge with scene 5
